name: Legazpi

queries.query: site:denr.gov.ph cadastral map parcel Philippines Legazpi; site:lmb.gov.ph cadastral map online Philippines Legazpi
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Geoportal Philippines lot-plotter, an LRA FOI response directing cadastral-map requests to DENR, a DENR-LMB FOI record for a Legazpi cadastral-map request, and official Legazpi City Assessor information. No public parcel polygon API was identified in search results.

queries.query: Legazpi mapa cadastral lote DENR Philippines; Legazpi mapa ng mga lote cadastral
queries.result: The Filipino-language discovery did not identify an additional public parcel-vector service. Indexed official material points to DENR/LMB and local assessor/tax-mapping procedures rather than anonymous parcel geometry access.

registryEvidence: Official LRA and DENR-LMB FOI records document cadastral-map custody/request routing through DENR/LMB; the official Legazpi City Assessor page identifies the local assessor as custodian of real-property assessment records, and the city service description documents tax-map viewing. This establishes local custodial/procedural evidence, not an open parcel-vector endpoint.
